description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTimesheetAPI class within the OrangeHRM system. It implements API endpoints for managing employee timesheets, including listing, creating, and updating timesheet entries. The class handles validation, authorization, and interaction with the timesheet service and data models, providing RESTful API operations for the employee timesheet resource.

classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing employee timesheets, including listing, creating, and updating entries.
